slides.text: every tape on this channel came from
the anime section at the video store.
it was just one shelf.
the best shelf.
ovatv.
ova stands for original video animation.
it went straight to tape, never to theaters.
on most shelves that was a warning.
here it is the whole point.
ovatv.
the box said "for mature audiences."
the clerk looked at you.
you looked at the clerk.
you rented it anyway.
ovatv.
no algorithm picked this for you.
a guy at a folding table at a convention did.
he was right about all of it.
ovatv.
back then you found anime one tape at a time.
copies of copies, traded at the club.
the picture got worse every time.
but the movies somehow got better.
ovatv.
somewhere a kid is rewinding a fight scene
for the fourth time.
we see you.
we did it too.
ovatv.
the opening song is in japanese.
you don't know the words.
you're singing along anyway.
so are we.
ovatv.
no "skip intro" button on these OVAs.
the intro is the best part.
it probably has a guitar solo and a sunset.
ovatv.
on this channel, if someone seems a little too calm,
they're probably a robot.
we're not saying who.
you can probably guess.
ovatv.
a lot of these movies end with the city blowing up.
it's usually tokyo.
tokyo has been through so much.
tokyo, we love you.
ovatv.
your parents thought cartoons were for kids.
then they walked in during the wrong scene.
that was a long conversation.
ovatv.
a viewer writes: "which tape should i start with?"
any of them.
you'll be up until three either way.
ovatv.
the whole anime club fit on one couch.
the couch is still the best seat in the house.
scoot over.
ovatv.
the giant robot takes a full minute to transform.
the villain waits.
nobody interrupts a transformation.
that's just good manners.
ovatv.
some of our tapes were recorded off tv on saturday nights.
the commercials are still on them. we left them in.
they're part of the show now. that's cable provenance.
ovatv.
akira came out in 1988.
every kid who rented it wanted kaneda's red bike.
none of us got the bike.
but we did get the tape.
ovatv.
lupin iii is a gentleman thief.
the castle of cagliostro was the first feature
hayao miyazaki ever directed.
lupin steals the car chase, the clock tower and the movie.
ovatv.
project a-ko is two high school girls
fighting over the same best friend.
they level half the city doing it.
high school was like that.
ovatv.
vampire hunter d is a quiet man in a big hat
who hunts vampires.
his left hand has a face, and it talks.
it has opinions he never asked for.
talk to the hand, literally.
ovatv.
galaxy express 999 is a steam train that runs through space.
a boy rides it to the end of the line.
nobody on board asks how the steam works.
we don't either.
ovatv.
serial experiments lain came out in 1998.
it was about the internet.
it understood the internet better than the internet did.
ovatv.
a few movies on this channel never came over in english.
they air in japanese, with subtitles.
we heard that watching anime with subtitles improves brain function.
probably best not to look it up.
ovatv.
fist of the north star is a man named kenshiro
walking across a wasteland, fixing it one punch at a time.
he tells his opponents they are already dead.
they never believe him.
they should.
ovatv.
tenchi muyo is about a teenage boy
whose house fills up with space princesses, a space pirate and a cabbit.
he just wanted to finish high school.
the title means "no need for tenchi."
nobody asked tenchi.
ovatv.
record of lodoss war started as friends playing a tabletop fantasy game,
written up in a magazine.
then it was novels. then it was this.
somewhere a dungeon master is very proud.
ovatv.
crying freeman is an assassin who cries
every time he does his job.
he is very good at his job.
bring tissues. for him, not you.
ovatv.
robot carnival is a stack of short films about robots,
nearly every one by a different director.
it opens with a carnival so big it rolls right over a village.
that's the warm-up.
ovatv.
perfect blue was satoshi kon's first feature.
a pop idol quits singing to become an actress.
it does not go well.
we'd tell you more, but we'd like you to sleep tonight.
ovatv.
